instruction: Chrome is set to open funbrain.com on startup. Change the startup setting to 'Continue where you left off'.

parameters.command: echo {CLIENT_PASSWORD} | sudo -S apt update -y && echo {CLIENT_PASSWORD} | sudo -S apt install jq -y
cd /home/user/.config/google-chrome/Default && jq '. + {"session":{"restore_on_startup":4, "startup_urls":["http://funbrain.com/"]}}' Preferences > temp && mv temp Preferences

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent navigated to Chrome Settings > On start-up, found funbrain.com configured as startup page, clicked context menu > Remove, resulting in 'Open the New Tab page' being selected. Evaluator returned 0 despite UI showing correct state.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can open Chrome three-dot menu, navigate to Settings, find On start-up section, interact with radio buttons and context menus to modify startup configuration
metadata.failure_analysis: Model appeared to complete the task (removed funbrain.com, 'Open the New Tab page' selected) but evaluator returned 0.0, likely due to Chrome preferences file not being synced or the new_startup_page getter checking a different condition than what the UI showed.
metadata.task_rationale: Simplified to changing startup setting to a specific option ('Continue where you left off') rather than the more ambiguous original task. The model demonstrated it can navigate to and interact with On start-up settings.
metadata.explanation: Task requires changing Chrome's startup behavior from 'Open a specific page' (funbrain.com) to 'Continue where you left off'. Evaluator reads Chrome Preferences file and checks restore_on_startup value equals 1.

scoring_breakdown.startup_setting: 1.0 - restore_on_startup changed to 1 (Continue where you left off)

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads Chrome Preferences file from /home/user/.config/google-chrome/Default/Preferences and extracts session.restore_on_startup value
Metric correctly accesses expected parameter directly (expected.get('expected_restore_on_startup')) — proper handling of type='rule' expected parameter
Expected value of 1 correctly corresponds to Chrome's 'Continue where you left off' startup setting
Config correctly sets initial state with restore_on_startup=4 (Open specific pages) and funbrain.com URL, matching the instruction precondition
Full instruction coverage: the only requirement is changing the startup setting, and the evaluator checks exactly that
